item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02190","case1_error":"Reduces the required rope length by 25% instead of accounting for loss from the purchased rope.","case2_error":"Subtracts the material cost of one necklace from revenue for 30 necklaces.","reason":"The first applies a loss factor to the wrong quantity; the second fails to scale unit cost to the number sold.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02191","case1_error":"Models five child tickets and five adult tickets instead of three child tickets and two adult tickets.","case2_error":"Adds the five lost points instead of subtracting them.","reason":"The first uses incorrect category counts in its equation; the second reverses the effect of a loss.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02192","case1_error":"Returns the total beverage volume without converting it to the required tea ingredient amount using the stated ratio.","case2_error":"Returns the weekly number of people as the daily number, omitting division by seven.","reason":"Both return an intermediate aggregate as the requested quantity, omitting the required ratio conversion.","judgment":"same"},{"pair_id":"J02193","case1_error":"Counts only the two friends' houses in the total, omitting Zion's house.","case2_error":"Treats the principal installment as already including interest, subtracting and then restoring interest instead of adding it.","reason":"The first omits a member from the combined total; the second incorrectly removes an additional charge before adding it back.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02194","case1_error":"Provides an unsupported final total of 22 after correctly writing (56 / 8) + (48 / 6), which gives 15.","case2_error":"Subtracts mint plants from the basil-only subtotal and omits parsley from the final count.","reason":"The first supplies a wrong final number after a correct formula; the second constructs the final count from an inappropriate subtotal.","judgment":"different"}]}
